name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal
task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task's "you must also open the door" after "if you pick up the key" has no timing cue, so RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) is the right template. It is hard because nothing marks the requirement as a preference. The machine's warning that the task is rule-only is correct, since the key pickup is conditional and no goal is commanded.

texts: If the agent picks up the key (comes to carry the matching key), the door must also be opened at some point, before, with, or after that.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
